checked_by: T-0019, the provenance sweep under ADR-0006 decision 7
method: Read the pack's whole read surface (PACK.md, CHECKS.md, guides/, refs/, exemplars/; research/ excluded as working notes) and compared each cited EV id against its row in registry/evidence.json. No source was re-fetched, so nothing here is a fresh licence check: every licence claim below is the ledger's own recorded value, read back. Quotation was checked three ways: every quotation-marked span in the read surface was listed and read; every enumeration or coined term that could only have come from a source was traced to the row that supplies it; and the rows whose ledger licence forbids reuse of wording were read against the prose that cites them. What this method cannot do is detect an unmarked sentence copied from a source nobody has the text of, and no claim of completeness is made on that.

quotation_concerns.concern: D11 names all four of the source's coined patterns (event notification, event-carried state transfer, event sourcing, CQRS) from EV-0163, whose ledger licence is unconfirmed and whose author reserves all rights on neighbouring rows.
quotation_concerns.resolution: Not a concern. Naming the four is the point of the rule and there is no other way to refer to them; the surrounding sentences are ours. Left as is.

quotation_concerns.concern: B1 describes the ISO 4217 list structure (EV-0283), whose reuse licence is unconfirmed.
quotation_concerns.resolution: Not a concern. The pack describes the structure and cites the row; no list content is reproduced. Left as is.

notes: Twenty of thirty cited rows carry a definite licence. One records that the source states none. The residual is nine, and the shape of it matters: this pack leans on practitioner essays, and the ledger already records several of them as Copyright Martin Fowler, all rights reserved, paraphrase only (EV-0206, EV-0272 to EV-0276). Those are recorded facts, not unknowns, and the prose citing them is ours throughout. The genuinely unconfirmed nine are EV-0150, EV-0157, EV-0163, EV-0269, EV-0271, EV-0282, EV-0283, EV-0284 and EV-0285. EV-0283 is worth the check first, because B1 rests on it and the currency lists are published free while the standard text is sold. A row marked states-none carries licence_evidence and a licence_checked date in the ledger, so somebody looked and recorded that the source states no licence. A row marked unconfirmed carries a hedged licence string and no licence_evidence, so nobody has looked. Both belong on the residual list ADR-0006 decision 7 asks for, and the difference between them is the difference between a recorded fact and a guess.
